messages:
maya: Quick q — we're getting tight on controllers for Saturday's LAN. Anyone have extra pads/dongles to spare? Also thinking pizza + potluck, who wants to chip in? :pizza:

dmitri: I can bring 2 wired Xbox pads and a USB hub (USB-A). Also a small surge strip. :thumbsup:

jamal: I have 2 DualSense I can bring. Bringing a veggie pizza and some hummus. FYI peanut allergy, please label dishes if they have nuts.

olivia: I can bring a Switch dock + 4 joy‑cons, but they might need AA batteries. I also have a 10m ethernet cable we can use.

katie: I have an 8-port unmanaged switch and a power strip. If people want GF pizza I can fetch one. Anyone care about vegan?

noah: What time are we starting? I can bring a spare wired fightstick and a 24" monitor.

maya: Start at 7pm in mezzanine A. Ops-bot: Room booking confirmed for Mezzanine A, 6:30–11:30. Please label controllers with names.

dmitri: Quick compatibility q — my hub is USB-C only, anyone bringing adapters?

olivia: We should have: [USB-A <-> USB-C], HDMI x2, Cat6 patch, and a USB-PS/adapter.

jamal: I also have AA rechargeables + a battery charger for joy‑cons. Bringing a battery pack too.

katie: Tiny config for the 8-port switch (plug-and-play, but labeling ports helps):
```
Port 1 - Mezz PC (host)
Port 2 - Olivia (Switch dock)
Port 3 - Noah (monitor / PC)
Port 4 - Maya (laptop host)
Port 5 - Spare
Port 6 - Guest
Port 7 - Jamal (PS)
Port 8 - Dmitri (Xbox)
```

olivia: Nice. Also @maya can you confirm we'll have a trash bin for pizza boxes? Last time ended up with a small mountain. :sweat_smile:

maya: Yep, facilities said they can drop a large bin and extra trash bags.

dmitri: Survey time — what should we prioritize? React with emoji: :crossed_swords: Smash, :rocket: Rocket League, :car: Mario Kart, :game_die: Jackbox

noah: Reacted :crossed_swords: and :rocket: — down for both.

jamal: :car: for me (Mario Kart) but I can play Smash too.

katie: I'll pick up GF/vegan slices if people confirm by Friday. Please DM me preferences.

maya: If Wi‑Fi gets flaky we’ll run local-only matches / LAN hosts. Bring offline builds where possible.

dmitri: Good call. I’ll bring an extra SSD with local ROMs / ISO backups for quick LAN hosting.

olivia: Spreadsheet for signups: https://tinyurl.com/redwood-lan (add your name + what you bring)

maya: Awesome team — see y'all Saturday! :party-parrot:
